participation.context: Refused the groat and stayed at the barrier.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Offered the poem, asked after Titus, and went on with his paper.
participation.name: George Peele

relations.quote: A groat for a poor poet? No? Wise man.

story.body: You met Peele as an old soldier meets another, and you kept the twelve pence you had already spent on the gate.

relations.quote: A groat for a poor poet? No? Wise man.

title: Nodded to Peele and refused the groat

participation.context: Wrote the line under one candle.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the tradesmen and the lion on the tables, and you left the day you had walked out of the note.

title: Wrote of hard-handed men afraid of the lion

story.body: You kept the reason you went, and you did not take it downstairs.

title: Wrote that the earl kept his seat
